questions.question: How is the Weierstrass function defined?
questions.explanation: The Weierstrass function is $f(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a^n\cos(b^n x)$ with $0<a<1$ and $ab>1$.
questions.source_support: This is the definition in the concept page.
option_explanations: $a>1$ would make the series diverge; the condition is $0<a<1$.
$\sum x^n/n!$ is $\mathrm{e}^x$, unrelated.
$a\cos(bx)$ is a single cosine, not the infinite series.
